title: deinandra frutescens
intro: Deinandra frutescens, commonly known as Isocryphalus frutescens or Monolias frutescens, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents present in Deinandra frutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. While more research is needed, Deinandra frutescens has been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential candidate for further pharmacological studies.
